# NeuromorphicSpikingTopology

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network architecture that uses spiking neurons and event-driven communication to form a topology-aware computational graph, often mapped onto physical wireless links. Aligns computation with communication topology, enabling energy-efficient and latency-aware distributed intelligence in TCC/iNEST systems.
